text.aria-label: Femoral, obturator and lateral femoral cutaneous nerves: anterior anatomy — 股神经、闭孔神经与股外侧皮神经：前面实体解剖
text.tspan: Femoral, obturator and lateral femoral cutaneous nerves: anterior anatomy
股神经、闭孔神经与股外侧皮神经：前面实体解剖

text.aria-label: Lateral femoral cutaneous nerve — 股外侧皮神经
Femoral artery and vein — 股动脉与股静脉
Iliacus and psoas major — 髂肌与腰大肌
Course, step by step — 走行步骤

svg.text: 股神经（L2–L4）从腰大肌外侧缘穿出。
It passes under the inguinal ligament,
它在腹股沟韧带深面、股动脉外侧通过。
In the femoral triangle it splits into
在股三角内分为肌支和皮支。
闭孔神经（L2–L4）从腰大肌内侧缘穿出。
It runs along the pelvic wall and exits
through the obturator canal to the
沿盆壁下行，经闭膜管到内收肌群。
passes just medial to the ASIS.
股外侧皮神经（L2–L3）在髂前上棘内侧穿出。

text.aria-label: Order in the groin, lateral to medial: nerve, artery, vein (NAV). — 腹股沟处从外到内：神经、动脉、静脉。
text.tspan: Order in the groin, lateral to medial: nerve, artery, vein (NAV).
腹股沟处从外到内：神经、动脉、静脉。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
